reading: and they [[having been cased|having been cased / plated with silver and standing so|περιαργυρόω]] [[to a piece of silver|to a piece of silver / silver coin, to money / a sum of money / cash, to silver|ἀργύριον]], and [[all|all / the whole, all, nothing but, every, everyone, every single, the whole, quite, full, of all kinds|πᾶς]] [[the pegs|the pegs, the gags|πάσσαλος]] [[of the court-yard|of the court-yard, of the wall of the court-yard, of the court / quadrangle, of the any court / hall|αὐλή]] [[in a circle|in a circle / ring / round about|κύκλῳ]] [[of copper|of copper / bronze / brasen, brasen|χαλκοῦς]].

greek: Καὶ αὕτη ἡ σύνταξις τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καθὰ συνετάγη Μωυσῇ τὴν λειτουργίαν εἶναι τῶν Λευιτῶν διὰ Ιθαμαρ τοῦ υἱοῦ Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως.
hint: The tent is arranged as Moses was ordered, its service given to the Levites under Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

notes.text: Aorist passive of συντάσσω, each sense in the passive.

λειτουργία: a liturgy, a public duty, any service or ministration, help, the public service, the service or ministry. The entry's list of the Athenian liturgies and its hence our word liturgy are set aside.
Ιθαμαρ genitive, after διά and before τοῦ υἱοῦ.

reading: And [[this|this, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]] [[the putting together|the putting together / arranging / arrangement / organisation / order, the rule, the systematic treatise, the narrative, the grammatical construction / syntax, the body of troops, the contingent, the covenant / contract, the assigned impost / contribution, the payment / allowance / pension|σύνταξις]] [[of the covered place|of the covered place / tent, of the camp, of the dwelling-place / house / temple, of the wooden stage, of the stage-effect / unreality, of the tented cover / tilt of a wagon, of the bed-tester, of the entertainment given in tents / banquet|σκηνή]] [[of the testimony|of the testimony / proof|μαρτύριον]], [[according as|according as / just as, like as if / exactly as|καθά]] [[was put in order together|was put in order together, was drawn up / put in array, was drawn up in line, was collected / resoluted / steadied, was arranged / organised, was concocted, was fixed / assessed, was organised for paying contributions, was ordained / prescribed|συντάσσω]] to [[name:Μωυσῇ]] [[the liturgy|the liturgy, the public duty, the any service or ministration / help, the public service, the service or ministry|λειτουργία]] [[to be|to be, to exist, to last|εἰμί]] of the [[name:Λευιτῶν]] [[through|through, right through, by means of, by the agency of|διά + genitive]] of [[name:Ιθαμαρ]] of the son of [[name:Ααρων]] [[of the priest|of the priest / sacrificer, of the minister|ἱερεύς]].

names.gloss: (Μωυσῆς, from Hebrew Mōšeh, which the Hebrew of 2:10 hears in māšâ, "to draw out")
(Ιθαμαρ, from Hebrew ʾÎtāmār, of uncertain meaning)
(Ααρων, from Hebrew ʾAhărōn, of uncertain meaning)

greek: καὶ Βεσελεηλ ὁ τοῦ Ουριου ἐκ φυλῆς Ιουδα ἐποίησεν καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ,
hint: Bezalel son of Uri, of the tribe of Judah, does the work as the Lord ordered Moses.

notes.text: The article as a noun with the genitive, the one of the Uri, as at 35:30.

(Ουριας, from Hebrew ʾÛrî, from ʾûr, "flame, light")
(Ιουδα, from Hebrew Yĕhûdâ, which the Hebrew of Genesis 29:35 hears in yādâ, "to praise")

greek: καὶ Ελιαβ ὁ τοῦ Αχισαμακ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Δαν, ὃς ἠρχιτεκτόνησεν τὰ ὑφαντὰ καὶ τὰ ῥαφιδευτὰ καὶ ποικιλτικὰ ὑφᾶναι τῷ κοκκίνῳ καὶ τῇ βύσσῳ.
hint: Eliab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, designs the woven and embroidered work in scarlet and linen.

notes.text: Not in Middle Liddell. LSJ gives it no gloss of its own, "= ῥαπτός", so the senses are Middle Liddell's ῥαπτός, as πόρευσις reads πορεία's at GEN 33:14. Used as a noun, it is headed by the entry's noun sense, ῥαπτόν, an embroidered carpet (Q30).
LSJ, skilful in embroidery: plain. LSJ's embroidery is the feminine made a noun, ἡ ποικιλτική; this is the neuter.
ἀρχιτεκτονέω, to be the architect, then to construct, contrive.

reading: and [[name:Ελιαβ]], the one of the [[name:Αχισαμακ]], [[out of|out of, out of / forth from, from, outside of / beyond, on, upon, for, after, in or by, by the hand of, of, in consequence, by means of, according to|ἐκ]] [[of the race|of the race / tribe, of the body united by ties of blood and descent, of the united by ties of blood and descent / clan, of the tribe by local habitation, of the hundred / county, of the contingent furnished by a tribe, of the brigade|φυλή]] of [[name:Δαν]], who [[was the architect|was the architect, constructed / contrived|ἀρχιτεκτονέω]] [[the woven|the woven, the brocaded|ὑφαντός]] and [[the embroidered carpets|the embroidered carpets, the stitched / patched, the strung together / continuous, the worked with the needle|ῥαφιδευτός]] and skilful in embroidery [[to weave|to weave, to weave / ply the loom, to contrive / plan / invent, to create / construct|ὑφαίνω]] to the scarlet and [[to the fine flax|to the fine flax, to the linen made from it|βύσσος]].

names.gloss: (Αχισαμακ, from Hebrew ʾĂḥîsāmāk, "my brother has supported")
(Δαν, from Hebrew Dān, which the Hebrew of Genesis 30:6 hears in dîn, "he judged")
